name: Sweden
work_strategy: Remote (Due to dark climate and taxes, it is better to live further south)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; then ~30–52% PIT + social contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Cold (Dark and long winters, depressing climate for many)
nature: Sea and Mountains (Scandinavian Mountains in the north, cold Baltic Sea)
english_level: Easy (Everyone speaks English, though a Swedish language exam is being introduced for citizenship)
housing_rent: Queues (Multi-year queue system for first-hand contracts, expensive second-hand market)
citizenship: 8 years (Increased from 5 to 8 years in June 2026)
mortgage_expats: Moderate (Requires Personnummer and strict loan amortization, 15% down payment)
rent_to_buy: None (Due to strict rental market regulation, hyrköp is almost non-existent)
